'''Giant giraffes''' are gargantuan versions of the giraffe, a long-necked grazer found roaming [[savage]] [[tropical]] [[savanna]]s and [[shrubland]]s. Being a giant creature, giant giraffes provide an absurd amount of (extremely valuable, being 5× the value of common domestic animals) butchering returns.

Giant giraffes also make decent exotic pets, but their real value lies as a staple of the [[meat industry]].
